label: Subramanian Raja Krishnamoorthi
narrative: Krishnamoorthi is on the Task Force on the Declassification of Federal Secrets and is on the record as one of the members who came out of the 12 January 2024 closed briefing with the Intelligence Community Inspector General empty-handed. His statement is short and it is the cleanest Democratic articulation of the pattern: 'Let's just say that all of us were very interested in the substance of his claims, and unfortunately, I didn't get the answers that I was hoping for.' That is a member of the intelligence-adjacent minority, in a SCIF, with the watchdog who declared Grusch's complaint credible and urgent in the room, reporting that he did not get answers - which is the coverup strand's point about the difference between access and disclosure.
